stop_behavior: Stop scheduling only; never terminate active jobs.
restart_behavior: Same exact argv and sealed inputs. Adopt exact own processes; ambiguous launches fail closed. Retry only documented GPU-busy no-child attempts after proof and archival.
gpu_reservation_limitation: Idle queries do not atomically reserve a GPU against foreign processes. Check immediately before launch; do not terminate foreign work.
requires_baseline: fingerprint matches frozen initialization, evaluator, runtime and data
placeholder_instructions: Replace angle-bracket placeholders with external local paths. Python environment, Isaac Gym, datasets, weights and runtime assets are external inputs; see parent EXPERIMENT.json.
